messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\n\nUsers cannot upload supplier invoices because the system rejects specific file formats. This blocks the claims process and prevents valid documents from being processed.\n\n## Who is affected\n\n- Cindermill Trade Cover, which holds an ARR of £210000.0 and renews on 2027-04-03 [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].\n- 1 account in total, carrying 1 mention across 1 route, so the evidence base is narrow [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].\n\n## Evidence\n\n- Support route: 1 mention, tied to Cindermill Trade Cover [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].\n- The customer's own words: \"the system won’t accept the supplier’s invoice format\" [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].\n- The mention was logged in September 2026 [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].\n- The fact sheet records 0 renewals in the next 90 days, so this is not attached to an imminent renewal decision [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].\n\n## Why now\n\n- The report dates from September 2026 and remains the only recorded instance, with 1 account, 1 mention and 1 route in the fact sheet as of 2026-11-03 [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].\n- No renewal falls within the next 90 days, so there is no renewal-driven deadline forcing action [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].\n- The absence of wider evidence should be weighed alongside the single report before treating this as a broader pattern [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].\n",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "e32f8ad103cb7bbe",
   "quote": "the system won’t accept the supplier’s invoice format",
   "account": "Cindermill Trade Cover",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-06T16:41:00+00:00"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-11-03",
  "accounts_n": 1,
  "mentions_n": 1,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "support": 1
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 210000.0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 0,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Cindermill Trade Cover",
    "arr_gbp": 210000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2027-04-03",
    "mentions": 1
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the quoted customer words against the cited insight: the brief's quote 'the system won't accept the supplier's invoice format' matches the insight verbatim. I verified the account details (Cindermill Trade Cover, £210,000 ARR, renewal 2027-04-03), the counts (1 account, 1 mention, 1 support route), the September 2026 date, and the 0 renewals in the next 90 days against the fact sheet — all match. The brief appropriately scopes the issue to a single account and flags the narrow evidence base rather than overstating it as a broader pattern. No uncited claims, misquoted paraphrases, or ignored contrary evidence were found.", "verdict": "pass"}
